text:
Sara (Sales): FYI team, new RFP from Orpheus Analytics. They want a private deployment proof: VPC peering, HSM-backed KMS, demonstrable audit logs, and an enterprise tier quote with reserved capacity + burst fallback. They attached an RFI and a questionnaire.

Priya (Orpheus): Quick context: we're evaluating for a search+semantic layer. Target throughput ~150 QPS embeddings and bursts to 400 for indexing. Latency target ~100ms P95 for embeddings. Data residency requirement: EU.

Tom (Solutions): OK. Proposed POC scope: 1) Private cluster in eu-west-1 with peered VPC 2) Bring-your-own-key test using HSM simulator 3) Run standardized embedding load and our latency script 4) Deliver capability matrix and cost scenarios (reserved vs on-demand). Estimate 10 business days.

Rebecca (Security): I'll own the RFI answers on crypto, key lifecycle, and logging. For HSM we can provide architecture doc + integration guide. Note: full production BYOK with HSM requires customer KMS certs and an HSM appliance conversation for on-prem.

Nate (Product): Model options: recommend baseline gpt-embed-xxl quantized int8 for cost/latency, and an fp16 variant for quality-sensitive tests. I'll add a column to the matrix for model fidelity vs cost.

Tom (Solutions): POC infra snippet for infra team to bootstrap:

```
cluster:
  region: eu-west-1
  deployment: private
  vpc_peering: true
  nodes: 6
  node_type: a2
  kms_provider: hsm-sim
  monitoring: datadog
```

Sara (Sales): Priya 97 when you say "audit logs" can you confirm the retention window they expect and whether they need token-level telemetry export?

Priya (Orpheus): Retention 180 days, and yes they want token-level usage metrics for compliance reporting (anonymized ok).

Jen (Legal): Heads-up: token-level telemetry export that includes content can trigger data processing addendum and additional controls. We'll likely need a DPA amendment and an explicit data handling clause.

Rebecca (Security): We can offer anonymized token metrics and full audit logs (access, requests, keys) to their SIEM via secure S3 export or syslog. I'll prepare the RFI entries and attach "hsm_integration_note.pdf" and "audit_export_playbook.pdf".

Tom (Solutions): Pricing callout: Reserved cluster sized for 150 QPS embeddings + buffer estimates at $YYk/mo. Hosted burst pricing for indexing spikes at per-token rates. I'll produce three scenarios: minimal, recommended, and high-availability.

Sara (Sales): Action items: Tom -> full POC runbook + perf matrix; Rebecca -> RFI answers + attachments; Nate -> add model/quant guidance to capability matrix; Jen -> draft DPA amendment language; I'll assemble the packet and send by EOD Thursday.

ci-bot: CI status for branch "orpheus-rfp": tests passed, infra plan lint OK.

Priya (Orpheus): Thanks all. We'll propose POC dates next week after we review your packet.

Sara (Sales): Great, team. Keep threads short on updates. :thumbsup:
